name: Sudhir Mhatre
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron deficiency anaemia and heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
Patient presents with fatigue on exertion, mild dyspnoea walking 200 m, and occasional palpitations. On exam: pallor, JVP not elevated, lungs clear, cardiac apex displaced laterally, S3 present, no edema. Smoking: former smoker, 10 pack-years, stopped 2018. Hb 9.0 g/dL, ferritin 12 ng/mL, MCV 78 fL; K+ 4.5 mmol/L, creatinine 1.2 mg/dL, NT-proBNP 800 pg/mL. Echo shows EF 35%, NYHA class II.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Transthoracic echocardiogram: Left ventricular ejection fraction 35% (normal 55-70). LV end-diastolic diameter 5.8 cm. Mild mitral regurgitation. No significant aortic stenosis. NYHA class II.
